_note: PvE AI tuning (PvE AI & Encounters). Per-kind attack numbers stay in abominations.json; this file holds how creatures hunt. Distances in metres, times in seconds, turn rates in radians per second. Behaviour briefs: docs/gdd/pve-ai.md.

awareness._note: Awareness fills 0..1. At suspicious the creature turns and investigates the stimulus; at 1 it hunts. Sight fill per second = sightRate * visibility * (1 - distance/range); peripheral (outer half of the field of view) fills at peripheralFactor. A noise adds noiseGain scaled by how far inside its radius the creature is. Awareness decays at decayRate while nothing is sensed.

light._note: Host visibility multiplies sight range and sight fill. Gunfire flashes the host for flashTime. Footprint glow (Plague-Stalker) multiplies on top via the virus cost.

tokens._note: At most `melee` creatures attack the host at once; the rest circle at ringRadius and feint. Keeps fights readable.

nestSpawn._note: Creatures pulsed out of a nest are flung outward and start hunting the host at once.

habitats._note: Where each kind lives (World layout habitat tags, most preferred first): grove, pool, interior, open, crater, ridge. Spawns and reinforcements come from these areas so players learn where each threat lives. spread: how far from an area's centre a spawn may sit, as a fraction of its radius. A kind with no matching area in a zone falls back to raid.json placement.
